_comment: Which providers exist, what they can do, and what they cost.
This file is the reason 'no quiero quedar atada a una unica API' is a
promise the code can keep: adding a provider is an entry here, swapping
one is editing 'enabled', and a price change is a config edit rather
than a code change. Nothing upstream of app/providers/ ever names one.
An entry whose api_key_env is unset is skipped silently at startup, so
this file can list everything and the machine runs whatever it has keys
for. With no keys at all, the local mock is used and says so.
PRICES MOVE. Verify before quoting her a figure - the cost line she sees
on every delivery is computed from these numbers.
The two tiers are the two-stage design: a cheap fast model she chooses
from, then a quality model only on what she chose.

providers.notes: Preview tier. Four steps, cheap and fast - it exists to give her something real to choose between, not to be the final photograph. NOTE: on fal, text-to-image and image-to-image are separate endpoints for this model, not one endpoint with a mode flag - hence i2i_model. Every look routes in_place_edit, so in practice the i2i path is the one that runs. VERIFY IT WITH check_provider.py BEFORE A REAL SESSION: if that path is wrong the call fails loudly, which is the point, but it fails.
Final tier. An edit model: it transforms her actual photo rather than inventing a body, which is where her real proportions come from. Hence the instructional dialect - 'change X, keep Y'.

FREE preview tier. Cloudflare Workers AI gives 10,000 neurons/day at no charge, reset 00:00 UTC, and hard-stops instead of billing. max_resolution MUST match the 4:5 portrait the app requests (PREVIEW_WIDTH x PREVIEW_HEIGHT = 512x640): the adapter caps each axis independently, so a square cap silently rendered every preview square, which for photographs of a person is simply wrong. Cost scales with 512px TILES, not pixels - 512x640 is 2 tiles, so 57.5 neurons and ~174 previews a day. Apache 2.0 model, commercial use permitted - the 4B specifically; klein-9B and flux-2-dev are NON-COMMERCIAL and must not be substituted here. cost_per_call_usd is genuinely 0, which means the bandit's value-per-euro ranking will always favour it; that is intended for the preview tier and is why it is not offered for finals.

FREE final tier. Shipped disabled originally, because klein-4B is below fal's flux-pro/kontext and finals are what she keeps. Enabled once the fal key turned out to be a Cloudflare token: with no paid tier registered there was no final tier AT ALL, and the router raised 'no provider serves tier=final' before a session could even start. A slightly worse photograph beats no photograph, and the paid tier takes precedence automatically whenever a valid fal key is present. It works, but klein-4B is a distilled 4B model and its output is below fal's flux-pro/kontext, which is what the paid final tier buys. Finals are what she actually keeps and shows people. Enable this only if the budget is truly zero, and tell her plainly that finals are a step down. 1024x1280 is 6 tiles, so 161.7 neurons and ~62 finals a day; a full session of 6 previews plus 3 finals is ~830 neurons, about 12 sessions daily. NOTE: this adapter cannot inpaint - the endpoint has no mask parameter - so the repair loop will decline rather than silently rewrite the whole photograph.
Second provider, same tier. Exists so the swap can be demonstrated live rather than merely claimed.
Final tier fallback. Pin a version once a look depends on it - a model that changes under her is a quality regression nobody ordered.
